name: ECEXCEL
recent: ECEXCEL 近期因 2022/2029 凭单转换而分两批发行新股（25,000 股及 63,800 股），并公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。公司同时出现审计委员会及提名与薪酬委员会成员变动。
notable: 2022/2029 凭单转换为新股，分别发行 25,000 股及 63,800 股，转换价为每股 RM0.54。
公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
Prof Dr Ting Wei Kiong 出现审计委员会及提名与薪酬委员会成员变动。
risks: 凭单转换导致新股发行，已发行股本增加，可能造成股权摊薄。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026
Change in Audit Committee - PROF DR TING WEI KIONG
Change in Nomination and Remuneration Committee - PROF DR TING WEI KIONG
ann.why: 提名与薪酬委员会变动

recent_en: ECEXCEL recently issued new shares in two tranches (25,000 and 63,800 shares) from the conversion of its 2022/2029 warrants, and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026. There were also changes in the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee memberships.
notable_en: Conversion of 2022/2029 warrants into new shares, with 25,000 and 63,800 shares issued at RM0.54 per share.
Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
Changes in the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee involving Prof Dr Ting Wei Kiong.
risks_en: Warrant conversions resulted in new share issuance and an increase in issued share capital, which may lead to equity dilution.
